message: I remember the first time we had a blackout when the kids were little. They thought it was the greatest adventure—running around with flashlights and trying to find the best hiding spots in the dark. Meanwhile, I was frantically checking my phone battery and hoping the fridge held out! It taught me the importance of keeping our power banks charged and having some cozy lanterns ready. It’s funny how a little darkness can spark so much creativity, isn’t it? How do you keep the fun alive during a power outage?
